extra_info: Steam is a digital game store and platform developed by Valve. It lets users buy, download, update, and play games, and includes community features.
task_instruction: Rewrite each direct request or order as reported speech.
paragraphs: At a community technology center, facilitator Priya leads an advanced workshop about Steam. She begins by asking participants to organize their game libraries. Priya instructed the group, {{red:Create a collection for the games you play most often.}} {{mask_1}} Then she asked Jordan, {{red:Please explain how you sort your library.}} {{mask_2}} Jordan described using categories. Priya reminded everyone, {{red:Do not share your account password with anyone.}} {{mask_3}}

The group reviews account security and privacy settings. Priya advised the participants, {{red:Enable the security options available on your account.}} {{mask_4}} Jordan asked Priya, {{red:Could you show us where the privacy settings are?}} {{mask_5}} Priya opened the settings menu. She warned the group, {{red:Never approve a sign-in request you did not start.}} {{mask_6}}

Next, the participants discuss game updates and storage space. Priya told Jordan, {{red:Check the download settings before you install a large game.}} {{mask_7}} Jordan asked her, {{red:Please demonstrate how to pause an update.}} {{mask_8}} Priya showed the relevant controls. She reminded the group, {{red:Do not turn off your computer while an update is still running.}} {{mask_9}}

The workshop moves to community features. Priya asked the attendees, {{red:Please review your profile before making it public.}} {{mask_10}} One participant asked, {{red:Could you explain how a friend invitation works?}} {{mask_11}} Priya described the invitation process. She cautioned everyone, {{red:Do not post personal contact details on a public profile.}} {{mask_12}}

A participant wants to organize a shared game night. Jordan asked the group, {{red:Please suggest a time that works for everyone.}} {{mask_13}} Priya instructed Jordan, {{red:Write the event details in the group announcement.}} {{mask_14}} Another attendee requested, {{red:Please include the time zone in the announcement.}} {{mask_15}} Jordan updated the draft.

Before the session ends, Priya helps the group find official support information. She encouraged participants, {{red:Use the official help page if you have an account problem.}} {{mask_16}} Jordan asked Priya, {{red:Could you send us the workshop notes afterward?}} {{mask_17}} Priya agreed. She reminded everyone, {{red:Do not enter your password on a page unless you have checked that it is the official service.}} {{mask_18}}

The participants review what they learned. Priya asked Jordan, {{red:Please summarize the main account-safety points.}} {{mask_19}} Jordan mentioned strong account protection and careful privacy choices. Priya told the group, {{red:Keep your recovery information up to date.}} {{mask_20}} The workshop ended with questions about libraries, updates, and community tools.
